title: ID0376076-DC/SI-D/SA[170002361] - Unable to initiate charging session
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Failed to start the charging sessions
Root cause:
StartTransaction (07a7627d-171c-43fe-ba7c-6efd5cf16dd3) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Invalid"}
Solution:
Inform the backend provider that it needs to accept the idTag="true"
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
